verses.text: Ex ix, b'ak'ech ex yuj he b'eyumal icha nok' wakax t'a Basán, ex kajan ex t'a tzalan yik chonhab' Samaria, ab'ek wal jun tik: Tzeyixtej heb' meb'a' yet' heb' ilb'ajk'ol yilji, tzeyalan t'a heb' winh eyetb'eyum: Ik'ekkot anh anh to skuk'ej anh, xe chi.

Ha Jehová haton Yajal yaji, ix slok sb'i ix yak'an sti', ix yalani: Ol k'och sk'ual, ol ak'chajoch gancho t'ayex, ol ex nherchajb'eyok, haxo heb' eyune', ol och lokan anzuelo t'a heb', ol jachchajb'at heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swala', tzololixonhej ol aj eyik'chajel b'aj ol mak'chaj poj pat chi', ol ex ik'chajpaxb'at t'a najat.
Ixikek t'a Betel yet' t'a Gilgal, tzeyak'anoch he mul icha he gana ta'. Slajwi chi' tzeyak'an eyofrenda t'a junjun k'inhib'alil, t'a schab'jial tzeyak'anpax he diezmo.
nhusek ixim pan ay yich t'a ofrendail yuj he ak'oj yuj diosal. Alekel t'a skal anima yuj jantak eyofrenda tz'el t'a he k'o'ol eyak'ani, yujto icha chi' he gana tze k'ulej.
Yuj chi', ix wak' eyab' sya'il wejel t'a masanil yol he chonhab' tik, palta manh yujok chi' ix ex meltzajkot t'ayin.

Ix wak'anoch wa'an nhab' t'a oxe' ujal ayik manto elul sat eyawb'en. Ix yak' nhab' t'a jun chonhab', haxo t'a junxo, ma'ay. Ay b'aj ix yak' nhab' chi', ay b'aj ma'ay, yuj chi' ix takjiel masanil eyawb'en.
Chab' oxe' chonhab'il ex ix ex b'at sayoj ha' t'a junokxo chonhab', palta maj yab'laj ha' yik tzek' stak'inhal he ti'. Tokwal yuj chi' ix ex meltzajkot t'ayin.

Ix wak' eyaelal yet' ik' te k'ak' yet' juntzanhxo ya'elal, ix wak'an ixtax tas tzeyawej yet' eyuwa. Haxo nok' k'ulub' ix k'uxanb'at te' eyigo yet' te' eyolivo. Tokwal yuj chi' ix ex meltzajkot t'ayin.

Ix wak'kot juntzanh ya'elal t'a eyib'anh, icha wal ix aj wak'anb'at ya'elal t'a Egipto. Ix cham heb' he kelemtak t'a skal owal, haxo heb' eyajk'ol chi' ix ikankan nok' he chej, ix eyab'an sjab' chamnak ayek' t'a he campamento. Tokwal yuj chi' ix ex meltzajkot t'ayin.

Ix ex wak' lajwokem icha ix aj wak'an lajwokem chonhab' Sodoma yet' Gomorra, yuj chi' a ex ixto ex kan tik, icha junok kuxk'ak' tz'ik'chajkanelta t'a yol k'ak', icha wal chi' eyaji. Tokwal yuj chi' ix ex meltzajkot t'ayin.
Icha chi' ol ex wutej ex aj Israel. Yuj chi' b'o'ek he b'a, yujto ol eyil-laj och he sat wet'ok a in he Diosal in tik.

Ha in Jehová in, ix in b'o niwak witz yet' ik', swak'an yojtakejel heb' anima tas nab'il wu'uj. Ha in swak' meltzajoch sakil k'inal t'a k'ik'alk'inalil, cha'anh tzin b'eyek' t'a yib'anh lum lum. Ha in b'i, haton Jehová Dios, Yajal in t'a Smasanil, xchi Jehová chi'.
